target.architecture_baseline: Apple arm64 compiler default for fixed arm64-apple-macosx12.0.0 triple; no host or CPU-feature detection

build_boundary.execution: producer-owned fixed direct-leaf graph; no CMake configure/build, shell, source build script, plugin, generator executable, downloader or source-tree write
build_boundary.sandbox: macOS Seatbelt deny-default; deny process-fork and all networking; allow sealed SDK/compiler-resource/source inputs and exact leaf-tool files; grant writes only on the fixed-capacity private APFS workspace image under generated, obj, output, logs, and tmp, never source snapshots
build_boundary.startup_read_exception: exact file-read-data permission on literal / for root-directory enumeration only; no descendant data access; root-directory device, inode, owner and mode recorded in each source plan

leaf_tools.role: launch one no-fork leaf under the fixed inherited profile

resource_limits.memory_enforcement: sample Darwin proc_pid_rusage RUSAGE_INFO_V4 ri_phys_footprint every 25 ms; cancel direct leaf on observed value above 8 GiB; not a kernel hard memory ceiling
resource_limits.write_scope: fixed-capacity APFS image/generated,obj,output,logs,tmp; source snapshots are read-only

build_boundary.leaf_lifecycle: one fixed direct leaf at a time; deny process-fork; parent owns exact PID, TERM then bounded grace then KILL, synchronously wait/reap before next leaf
build_boundary.failed_workspace_policy: after all direct leaves are reaped, delete only this run's private image and mount directory; never delete source-stage or preexisting paths; retain successful detached image and receipt for owner-managed disposal
build_boundary.source_immutability: descriptor-rooted no-follow traversal and copy; verify every archive against the frozen SHA-256 and every extracted/copied file through the approved Git tree ID before and after; reject source mutation; preserve reviewed archives and complete license/notice closure

compiler_recipe.driver_mode: no-default-config -### metadata only to derive explicit fixed cc1 argv; never invoke compiler driver during vendor build
compiler_recipe.ggml_cpu_fp16_format: AArch64 __fp16 uses IEEE binary16 by default; pinned Clang defines __ARM_FP16_FORMAT_IEEE; -mfp16-format=ieee is only needed on 32-bit Arm

llama_model_source_resolution.unity_build: CMake UNITY_BUILD ON, default BATCH mode, batch size 16; sorted GLOB model sources are grouped consecutively into generated unity translation units and compiled in target source order

transform: common.h then only headers explicitly matched by the pinned CMake source-include checks, then kernel source
remove exact internal include/pragma-once directive lines; reject malformed or duplicate transform tokens
replace the optional unique ggml-common.h embed sentinel with pinned ggml-common.h bytes
replace exactly one ggml-metal-impl.h include from common.h with pinned bytes
emit one fixed assembly section __DATA,__ggml_metallib with exact start/end symbols and .incbin for each source string
embedded_metal.assemble: clang -cc1as -triple arm64-apple-macosx12.0.0 -filetype obj; exact argv and output object are recorded per kernel in metadata plan and artifact receipt
embedded_metal.runtime_loader: MTLDevice newLibraryWithSource from embedded source; Foundation, Metal and MetalKit are linked by worker
embedded_metal.generated_version_headers: data-only configure_file-equivalent templates; fixed values from pinned source versions and complete pinned commit IDs rather than CMake source-archive fallback unknown; exact generated bytes and SHA-256 are recorded before build

resources: embedded Metal source strings in libSaturdayLlamaRuntime.a
embedded Metal source strings in libSaturdayWhisperRuntime.a
